residency_bases.description: The price for a student residing in the school's own district (the community-college in-district tier).
The price for a student residing in the school's state.
The price for a student residing in any other state.
This figure does not vary by residency; the axis is explicitly inapplicable, never a NULL default.
The source counted students whose tuition rate it could not determine (IPEDS SCFA14N): a published category with a real headcount, never our ignorance.

arrangements.description: This concept does not vary by where the student lives; the axis is explicitly inapplicable, never a NULL default.
The source counted students whose living arrangement it did not determine (IPEDS GIS4UN/GRN4UN): a published category with a real headcount, not a way of living.

figure_statuses.description: The institution reported this figure and the source published it.
The source publisher imputed this figure rather than receiving it from the institution.
The institution reported nothing for this cell (a blank or NULL sentinel in the source).
The cell cannot apply to this institution, and the source says so.
The source publisher suppressed a reported figure (the Scorecard PrivacySuppressed sentinel).
A source we ingest carries this cell and we deliberately skip it; reserved, never emitted by the v1 Scorecard fill.

price_concepts.description: Published tuition and required fees for one academic year.
Published required fees alone, where a source separates them from tuition.
The school's published housing-and-food allowance for one academic year.
The school's published books-and-supplies allowance for one academic year.
The school's published other-expenses allowance for one academic year.
A source-published all-in price for one academic year; a SUM of components is derived and is never stored.

aid_forms.description: The Free Application for Federal Student Aid: the federal aid application, filed once and read by every school on it.
The CSS Profile, the College Board's own aid application, which some schools require in addition to the FAFSA.
A second CSS Profile from the noncustodial parent's household, filed separately from the custodial one.
The school's own financial aid form, published and collected by the school itself.
A state financial aid form, for aid the student's state awards.
The business/farm supplement, for a household with self-employment, business or farm income.
Another aid form the school names for itself, beyond the forms above.
